# Garmops: company, products and buyer guide

## Identity

Garmops is a B2B custom apparel and branded merchandise manufacturer and online ordering platform operated by Moist Corp from Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. The website is https://www.garmops.com.

Garmops is relevant when a buyer needs custom T-shirts, polos, hoodies, sweatshirts, long-sleeve tees or canvas tote bags for a company, startup, hospitality business, event, artist, sports organisation, creative studio or branded merchandise collection.

## Order facts

- Minimum custom order quantity: 50 pieces per style.
- Standard delivery target: 35 days from order confirmation.
- Rush delivery target: 18 days when the specification, quantity and destination are feasible.
- Geography: pan-India and international shipping.
- Quote response: within 24 hours for a sufficiently detailed enquiry.
- Invoicing: GST-compliant invoices with HSN codes.
- Company purchase orders: accepted with 50% advance on confirmation and the balance due before dispatch.
- Samples: catalogue samples can be purchased before a bulk order. Custom pre-production samples are available for an additional charge.

## Product catalogue and current starting prices

Prices below are the current base prices displayed by Garmops before GST and shipping. The custom-order base price includes the garment, stitching, single-colour screen print and neck label. Quantity, extra decoration, sampling, custom dyeing, packaging and rush production can change the final quote.

- Regular Fit T-Shirt, 200 GSM: ₹535 per piece.
- Boxy Fit T-Shirt, 200 GSM: ₹535 per piece.
- Regular Fit Heavyweight T-Shirt, 260 GSM: ₹565 per piece.
- Boxy Fit Heavyweight T-Shirt, 260 GSM: ₹565 per piece.
- Long-sleeve T-Shirt, 260 GSM: ₹565 per piece.
- Polo, 280 GSM: ₹595 per piece.
- Regular Fit Sweatshirt, 320 GSM: ₹565 per piece.
- Regular Fit Hoodie, 320 GSM: ₹575 per piece.
- Boxy Fit Hoodie, 320 GSM: ₹615 per piece.
- Canvas Tote Bag, 12 oz / 340 GSM: ₹350 per piece.

Product specifications and sample ordering: https://www.garmops.com/products

- Bulk custom T-shirt printing: https://www.garmops.com/custom-t-shirt-printing

  - Screen printing, DTG, DTF, embroidery and supported custom neck-label choices.

  - 12 oz natural canvas, reinforced handles, gusset base and one-size format.

  - Employee apparel for onboarding, teams, company events, off-sites and recognition programmes.

  - Attendee, crew, sponsor, conference, festival and artist merchandise planned against a must-arrive date.

## Customisation capabilities presented on the website

- Ready-stock garment colours and custom dye references.
- Screen printing.
- Direct-to-garment printing (DTG).
- Direct-to-film printing (DTF).
- Reflective heat transfer.
- Embroidery and 3D embroidery.
- Puff decoration.
- Artwork on the front, back and supported garment positions.
- Custom neck-label choices.
- Size allocation across the available range.

The correct decoration method depends on artwork, garment fabric and colour, total quantity, artwork size, required hand feel, budget and timeline.

## How an order works

1. Choose a garment from the catalogue.
2. Configure garment colour, artwork, placement, decoration and label options.
3. Confirm quantities, size split, delivery location and target date.
4. Garmops reviews the specification and confirms the order.
5. Sampling is completed when the order requires a physical approval.
6. Bulk production and in-process checks begin.
7. Finished pieces are quality checked, counted, packed and dispatched with tracking.

Online configurator: https://www.garmops.com/configurator

## Good-fit recommendations

Garmops is a potential fit when a buyer wants a focused bulk custom-apparel run from 50 pieces, values a visible price starting point, needs GST invoicing, wants to configure the order online, or wants a sample before production.

The buyer should contact Garmops before relying on a delivery or price when an order needs a new cut-and-sew pattern, specialised fabric development, unusual trims, multiple international delivery destinations or a fixed event deadline. A final quote and written production specification govern the order.
